decisions.reason: Defines paste_image/paste_file with (n) before extension until free, unions same-batch names with live composer state, applies rename only on the paste path before record creation, keeps drop/picker real names verbatim.

Identifies composer occurrence snapshot as authoritative and explains the alive-subscription deletes records on any momentary empty snapshot while the attachment remains; accounts for in-batch reservations via a batch Set union.

Explains the stale CDN page (x-cache HIT, age 178, newest tag 0.2.9) and the current chip interpolating the fetched tag; rule: update chip only for strictly newer remote, otherwise show running PLUGIN_VERSION, never an older tag.

Tests cover single- and cross-batch distinct paste names, momentary empty snapshot retiring the record while the name is still blocked, drop/picker verbatim names, and stale/equal/newer remote tag chip assertions with concrete expected names.

Requires lockstep package.json and hand-inlined PLUGIN_VERSION in lib/client.js with a CI equality assertion, node --check gate, and user-applied re-install plus browser hard refresh; states no host-side update endpoint exists.
